devdoc.author: @amusingaxl
devdoc.details: This proxy uses `delegatecall` to execute calls from context isolated from the main governance contract. Contracts that must be controlled by SubDAO governance must authorize the `SubProxy` contract instead of the governance contract itself.
devdoc.title: SubProxy: the SubDAO-level `PauseProxy`.

deny(address).notice: Revokes `usr` admin access from this contract.

exec(address,bytes).notice: Executes a calldata-encoded call `args` in the context of `target`.

rely(address).notice: Grants `usr` admin access to this contract.

wards(address).notice: Addresses with owner access on this contract. `wards[usr]`
